30 actual-model comparisons preserve real hull/death and omissions. Historical collision/runtime audits remain required.
Serial real Three.js profiles record45s each, cold/warm frame outliers, CPU, long tasks and ten same-phase restarts. Native WebM has associated RAF pose traces.
Production bytes and76 approved model histories are compared, including12 mixed-flow histories. Unrelated user work is fingerprinted and excluded.
limitations: Conditional route existence is not arbitrary-input safety, complete search or human acceptance.
Enclosing sphere is conservative between mine arms; distant readability and grazing need owner review.
Blind steering can compromise existing geometry and cause fallback/omission; mines are never force-spawned.
Cold and33ms+ gaps are retained. Emulated mobile viewports and finite V8 retention do not prove physical-device or indefinite memory behavior.
knownBlockers: Owner playtest and independent review before merge or further integration. No human results are claimed.
